----Find Duplicates Records
USE nyc_taxi_discovery;

SELECT 
   LOcationId,
   COUNT(1) AS total_Count
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlscoursesynapse.dfs.core.windows.net/nyc-taxi-green-data/raw/taxi_zone.csv',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
)AS [result]  
GROUP BY LocationID
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1 ;


SELECT 
    Borough,
    COUNT(1) AS NUMBER_CONT
FROM
    OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://adlscoursesynapse.dfs.core.windows.net/nyc-taxi-green-data/raw/taxi_zone.csv',
        FORMAT = 'CSV',
        HEADER_ROW = TRUE,
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0'
)AS [result]  
GROUP BY Borough
HAVING COUNT(1) > 1;
